findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Group/Measure.lean:330 `measurePreserving_inv` needs only `[Inv G] [MeasurableInv G] [IsInvInvariant μ]`; MeasurableEquiv.lean:183 `MeasurableEquiv.inv (G) [MeasurableSpace G] [InvolutiveInv G] [MeasurableInv G]`. The only group fact used outside the ClassFunction section is `inv_inv` (l.73).
findings.fix: Bind `[InvolutiveInv G] [MeasurableInv G]` in the top `variable` block and move `[Group G] [MeasurableMul G]` into `section ClassFunction`. This admits the `GroupWithZero`-style carriers (e.g. `dx/x` on `ℝ` with `0⁻¹ = 0`) that are inversion-invariant but not groups.
findings.issue: `[Group G]` is stronger than anything the core declarations use: `invLpₗᵢ`, `coeFn_invLpₗᵢ`, `invLpₗᵢ_invLpₗᵢ`, `invLpₗᵢ_eq_zero_iff` and `invLpₗᵢ_toLp` mention no multiplication — they need only `Inv`/`InvolutiveInv` (for `inv_inv`). Only the `ClassFunction` section (l.82-112), which conjugates, needs the group.

findings.evidence: TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/Lp/CompMeasurePreservingEquiv.lean:92 `compMeasurePreservingₗᵢEquiv`, docstring l.14-18: "Transporting structure between `L²` spaces — a Hilbert basis, ... — needs the equivalence, since `HilbertBasis.mapₗᵢ` and its relatives consume `≃ₗᵢ`"; Inversion.lean:71-73 already passes `(.of_eq (funext inv_inv))` to that file's `compMeasurePreserving_comp_apply_of_ae_id`.
findings.fix: Define `invLpₗᵢ : Lp E p μ ≃ₗᵢ[𝕜] Lp E p μ := Lp.compMeasurePreservingₗᵢEquiv 𝕜 (Measure.measurePreserving_inv μ) (Measure.measurePreserving_inv μ) (.of_eq (funext inv_inv))` and drop `invLpₗᵢ_eq_zero_iff` in favour of the equiv's `map_eq_zero_iff`.
findings.issue: `invLpₗᵢ` is defined as `→ₗᵢ` although precomposition with an involution is an isometric automorphism; the involutivity and injectivity are then re-proved by hand (l.70, l.79). The file already imports `TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Function/Lp/CompMeasurePreservingEquiv.lean`, whose stated purpose is exactly this upgrade, and l.71-73 already assembles its `hfg` argument.

summary: The representation-theoretic content of Character/Basis.lean sits at the natural level (arbitrary orthonormal basis, inequivalence-only orthonormality, skeleton only where completeness needs it). Two level issues in TauCeti/MeasureTheory/Group/Inversion.lean: the file assumes `Group G` where `InvolutiveInv G` suffices, and bundles an involution as a one-sided linear isometry.
